questions.question: Before starting work in a mechanical room, what should a plumber do first?
options: Inspect the work area for hazards
Ask another worker to start cutting pipe
questions.explanation: A safe work environment starts with identifying hazards such as poor lighting, wet floors, electrical risks, chemicals, or confined spaces.

questions.category: A2 — Use Personal Protective Equipment and Safety Equipment
questions.question: What PPE should be worn when cutting pipe with a grinder?
questions.explanation: Cutting and grinding can produce sparks, flying metal, and debris, so eye and face protection are required.

questions.category: A3 — Perform Lock-Out and Tag-Out Procedures
questions.question: What is the purpose of lock-out/tag-out?
options: To prevent accidental start-up or release of stored energy
questions.explanation: Lock-out/tag-out protects workers from unexpected energizing, start-up, or release of pressure, electricity, steam, or mechanical energy.

questions.question: Before soldering near combustible material, what should be done?
options: Ignore the material if work is quick
questions.explanation: Combustible materials must be protected or removed to prevent fire.

questions.category: B1 — Use Common Tools and Equipment
questions.question: Which tool is most commonly used to tighten or loosen threaded pipe?
questions.explanation: A pipe wrench grips round pipe and fittings for turning.
